note: achat de 14 000 machines S19j Pro livrables au T1 2023, réglé par les acomptes déjà versés à Bitmain
quote: The Agreement provides that Lake Mariner will receive 14,000 S19j Pro miners from Bitmain for delivery in Q1 2023 for a total purchase price of $22.4 million, which the Company will pay for using its remaining unused deposits with Bitmain at no additional cost to the Company.
